formulas.band: [a/d_hi, a/d_lo] (the scene drive law's fixed-point span)
formulas.segment_range: two-sided comparison bound: v_t - a/d in [(v0-a/d)(1-dt*d_hi)^t, (v0-a/d)(1-dt*d_lo)^t]
formulas.stride_setpoint: s = v_cmd * d_hi / STRIDE_GAIN (clip to bounds)
formulas.yaw_phase_off: off_l = clip(-yaw/4, lo0, hi0); off_r = clip(+yaw/4, lo4, hi4)
